project_type: Python AWS Lambda functions for AI agent game (AWS AI League)
build_system: No build system - pure Python lambdas, no packaging step
test_framework: pytest and unittest - tests in tests/test_agent.py, uses _invoke helper to call lambda_handler directly
build_command: python -c 'import memoryquestion; import pathfinding; import codeexecutor; import webscraper; print("OK")'
verification_instructions: Run python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short and confirm all tests pass including new memory store/retrieve tests
environment_constraints: No external network needed for tests. Lambda functions run standalone. pyenv 3.12.13 is configured.
contribution_requirements: No formal CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing patterns in codebase.
key_patterns: Each lambda has a lambda_handler(event, context) that returns {'statusCode': int, 'body': json_string}. Tests use _invoke() helper that extracts and parses the body. Events can have a 'body' key (API Gateway style) or be direct dicts. The _err() helper returns error responses.
directory_structure: Flat repo: lambda .py files at root, system prompts as .txt files, tests/ directory with test_agent.py
